statement: If an integrable process (X_1, X_2, X_3) satisfies E[X_{n+1} | X_n] = X_n for each n (conditioning only on the current value), then it is a martingale with respect to its natural filtration.
definitions: Natural filtration F_n = sigma(X_1,...,X_n); martingale means E[X_{n+1} | F_n] = X_n a.s. for each n; all X_n integrable.
